title: The lost-state accident, and surviving it

videos.script: Somebody deletes a file in a bucket. It looked old. It was the Terraform state. {{delete}} Nothing in the account changed. Every resource is still there, serving customers. But Terraform has forgotten it made them. {{forgot}} Its next plan wants to create everything again. The plan looks calm, and it is wrong. {{plan}} This lesson stages the accident on purpose. It applies the wrong plan and reads what happens, one resource at a time. One is adopted in silence. Three fail. {{apply}} Then two ways back. The state's own history, in the versioned bucket. And when there is no history, import blocks that tell Terraform about each resource again. {{back}} By the end, you have recovered a state once, before the day you need to. And a plan that wants to create something you know exists makes you stop. {{end}}
